description: The most recent closed EBSA civil-penalty enforcement actions, newest first, optionally restricted to one case type or state. Returns plan, sponsor, case type, close date/reason and penalty bucket for each. Use for "what EBSA enforcement actions closed recently".

_apiKey.description: Optional. Your own free DOL Open Data Portal key (dataportal.dol.gov); omit it to use the platform key.

case_type.description: Restrict to one case type, e.g. "Deficient Filer".

state.description: Restrict to one plan-administrator state as DOL records it (e.g. "California").

name: ebsa_recent
